tools.name: vmem_status
tools.description: Registered vaults with health, write policy, effective pii and the piiPolicy matrix (read-only).

tools.name: vmem_search
tools.description: Full-text (BM25) search over indexed notes. Literal AND terms. Supply model and vector together for local hybrid ranking with stored embeddings.

tools.name: vmem_enrichment_work
tools.description: List a bounded page of notes needing one implemented enrichment kind.

tools.name: vmem_enrichment_intake
tools.description: Submit bounded enrichment output for a source note. Kind-specific validation, PII screening, source hash checks and current vault write policy apply.

tools.name: vmem_enrichment_get
tools.description: Read one current enrichment record after rechecking its source hash and current disclosure policy.

tools.name: vmem_enrichment_reconcile
tools.description: Preview, then explicitly confirm after inspecting the journal or proposals, resolution of an uncertain intake as published or not_published. A wrong resolution can allow a duplicate or suppress work.

tools.name: vmem_similar
tools.description: Find notes nearest to a note with a current stored embedding.

tools.name: vmem_brief
tools.description: Intent-ranked note pointers and one-hop neighbors, with metadata PII/deny screening and whole-line byte cap including the result JSON. No note bodies; read a selected pointer with vmem_read.

tools.name: vmem_read
tools.description: Read one note by stem, alias or notes/ path: frontmatter, body, sha256. Bounded by maxBytes; section selects an exact H2, offset pages UTF-8 byte ranges, and truncated reads list H2 headings/nextOffset. With revision, read that full commit id's blob for the path instead: the result carries revision, blob and content sha256 plus basis git_snapshot, within the 48 KiB transport bound.

tools.name: vmem_read_many
tools.description: Read up to 20 notes (8 KiB each).

tools.name: vmem_list
tools.description: List indexed notes under notes/ in path order, optionally by stem prefix, with each note's mtime and the filtered total. Pass the returned nextCursor as cursor for the next page.

tools.name: vmem_links
tools.description: Outgoing links (with resolution) and/or incoming backlinks of a note. Each dead link carries at most one suggested existing target from the title search, with its score; it is a hint and the link is never rewritten.

tools.name: vmem_history
tools.description: Read-only Git snapshot history of one note path, newest first: full commit ids reachable from the vault HEAD, blob ids, sizes and Git commit metadata (never assertion time). Pinned to the HEAD the first page saw; pass the returned continuation as cursor. First-parent only, exact path only, at most 1000 commits traversed. Non-repositories, shallow history, unavailable Git, unreachable or pruned objects, revision expressions, symlinked and denied paths are reported or refused explicitly, never replaced with current content.

tools.name: vmem_changes
tools.description: Compare two pinned commits over notes/ only: path, status and before/after blob ids, never a content diff. Both ids must be full commits reachable from the vault HEAD. At most 500 paths per page with a continuation cursor; denied and symlinked entries stay out.

tools.name: vmem_mocs
tools.description: MOC notes with incoming link counts.

tools.name: vmem_check
tools.description: Validate a prospective note text without writing.

tools.name: vmem_log_tail
tools.description: Read the newest vault log lines, optionally filtered.

tools.name: vmem_create
tools.description: Create a validated note. Requires a vault with write=mcp.

tools.name: vmem_patch
tools.description: Replace exact strings in a note: one oldString/newString pair, or edits (1..32 pairs, each matching once in the original text, non-overlapping) applied all-or-nothing with one receipt and one log event.

tools.name: vmem_append
tools.description: Append markdown to a section of a note.

tools.name: vmem_set_frontmatter
tools.description: Set or unset frontmatter keys of a note.

tools.name: vmem_link
tools.description: Add a typed relation link between two notes (bidirectional by default). One step by default. Opt-in two-step: preview=true returns the planned changes to each note, the log event and a fingerprint without writing; confirm=true with that fingerprint writes only while it still matches, otherwise a fresh preview (stale=true) is returned and nothing is written.

tools.name: vmem_supersede
tools.description: Mark a note superseded by another.

tools.name: vmem_log_append
tools.description: Append one validated event line to the vault log.

tools.name: vmem_move
tools.description: Two-step rename with link rewrites: without confirm returns preview and fingerprint; then confirm=true with that fingerprint (pass log on the confirm call).

tools.name: vmem_merge
tools.description: Two-step note merge: without confirm returns merged body, source/topic unions, inbound link rewrites and fingerprint without writing. Then confirm=true with that fingerprint writes keep, repoints inbound links and marks absorb superseded under one mutation lock (pass log on the confirm call). Different types, person/moc notes and oversized results refuse.

tools.name: vmem_delete
tools.description: Two-step delete: without confirm returns preview (or refusal), backlinks and fingerprint; then confirm=true with that fingerprint (pass log on the confirm call).

tools.name: vmem_promote_from_amem
tools.description: Two-step promotion of one durable agent-mem entry (id from amem_vault_candidates) into a vault note: without confirm returns the full note text, possible duplicates and fingerprint; confirm=true with that fingerprint creates the note, logs LEARN and records the agent-mem vault link. linkTo links an existing note instead. Configured canonTables add advisory canonical row matches and link-existing choices, outside the fingerprint and never blocking confirm.

tools.name: vmem_lint
tools.description: Lint a private derived snapshot; write=true writes a screened report.

tools.name: vmem_graph_build
tools.description: Build a deterministic graph and screened reports; dryRun changes nothing.

tools.name: vmem_graph_neighbors
tools.description: Read a bounded graph neighborhood.

tools.name: vmem_graph_path
tools.description: Read the shortest undirected link path between two notes (BFS, code-point tie order). MOC/bu hubs are not intermediates unless viaHubs. found=false when no path within maxHops (default 6).

tools.name: vmem_graph_explain
tools.description: Explain the vmem_graph_path selection hop by hop from the same snapshot: each hop lists the link occurrences behind its edge (origin note path and sha256, line, UTF-8 byte range, body or frontmatter field, declared relation, authored from/to and forward/reverse traversal). legacy_graph_match marks the matches the graph used, with authored=true when also a validated link; anchored and frontmatter references are annotations that add no edge. structuralOnly=true: no quote proves a link and nothing is a probability. 20 occurrences per hop and 48 KiB total, with omitted counts. Writes nothing.

tools.name: vmem_promote
tools.description: Two-step promotion of a personal note into a local org vault clone (never pushes): without confirm returns the full transformed text, dropped links, screen result and fingerprint; confirm=true with that fingerprint writes the org note, source provenance and SYNC log lines. Configured target-vault canonTables add advisory canonical row matches and link-existing choices; personal rows are never included and matches do not affect the fingerprint or block confirm. Publishing is the separate `vmem sync` CLI.

tools.name: vmem_skills_mine
tools.description: Read-only skill-candidate mining over amem curated entries, amem capture rows and vault notes: dictionary matching, deterministic communities and novelty scoring. Returns counts, masked candidates and a markdown report; writes nothing.

tools.name: vmem_read_file
tools.description: Read one UTF-8 file outside notes/: ops/, reports/, self/, templates/, AGENTS.md or README.md. Same bounds and paging as vmem_read (maxBytes, offset, nextOffset); notes/ use vmem_read, the log vmem_log_tail. Never locks or writes.

tools.name: vmem_list_files
tools.description: List one directory level under ops/, reports/, self/ or templates/ (up to 500 entries; dot, linked and denied entries omitted). Never locks or writes.

tools.name: vmem_report
tools.description: Write a screened report file under reports/ or ops/ (the MCP form of `vmem report`): same path rules, screening, write policy (write=mcp), receipt and EXTRACT log event; log overrides it, for example a LINT or GRAPH event. dryRun changes nothing.

tools.name: vmem_evidence
tools.description: Verify a note's version-1 evidence entries (source, sha256, quote, optional section): flat notes/*.md sources in the same vault are re-read on every call and reported verified, stale, missing, ambiguous or unsupported with UTF-8 byte offsets; other references are unverified_external without I/O. Proves that quoted bytes occur in a source version, not that a claim is true. Writes nothing, takes no lock, keeps no cache.

tools.name: vmem_stats
tools.description: Read-only vault statistics: note counts by type, domain and status, note bytes and words in total and by type and domain, and the note-to-source byte ratio (median, p90 and the largest notes) over the workspace files the notes cite. A source counts at its own byte size on disk, so a decoded byte count never inflates a file that is not UTF-8; non-file, unreadable and over-cap sources are skipped and counted, and `truncatedNotes` counts the sourced notes the ratio's 10000-note cap left out. Also notes modified in the last 7 and 30 days, and log event counts by type over the last `days` (default 30). Writes no vault file or log and takes no vault or log lock.

tools.name: vmem_proposal_submit
tools.description: Screen and save one create, exact-patch or inferred-link proposal without modifying vault notes or the log. Agent labels are unverified.

tools.name: vmem_proposal_list
tools.description: List screened proposal summaries, pending by default; pass nextCursor as after.

tools.name: vmem_proposal_show
tools.description: Read a screened proposal operation in UTF-8 pages, with the complete encoded response bounded to 48 KiB.

tools.name: vmem_proposal_apply
tools.description: Preview an apply, then confirm with its fingerprint. An interrupted apply remains apply_unknown and is never replayed automatically.

tools.name: vmem_proposal_reject
tools.description: Preview rejection with a reason, then confirm with the returned fingerprint; rejection does not change vault notes or log.

tools.name: vmem_proposal_reconcile
tools.description: Preview an uncertain apply using the target and durable writer receipt; confirm only with the preview fingerprint. Matching content alone does not prove attribution.

tools.name: vmem_assert
tools.description: Append one all-or-nothing batch of 1..32 temporal assertion operations (declare, relink, assert, revise, retract) to the vault's append-only assertions/ journal; the MCP form of `vmem assert`. Relink changes a declared subject's note while retaining its identity and label. vmem assigns ids, rev, recorded_at and hashes. Each assert or revise needs evidence (path sources verified at append) or source references; revise and retract need expected_heads equal to the current head set. Writes no note; a log line only with log. dryRun validates without lock or append. Requires write=mcp. Request and reply stay within 48 KiB.

tools.name: vmem_assertions
tools.description: Read verified temporal assertions with current policy and bounded pages. The journal is the source of truth; results include a verified pin and coverage. Pass continuation as cursor.

tools.name: vmem_assertions_purge
tools.description: Two-step purge of one assertion's payloads from the append-only journal: without confirm it returns the affected entries, segment counts and a fingerprint and writes nothing. confirm=true with that fingerprint rewrites each affected segment through a temporary file and a rename under assertions.lock, removes payload, keeps payload_sha256 and every hashed field, and adds purged {at, reason}, so the chain still verifies; reads then show the assertion as unavailable and count it in coverage.purged. The reason stays in the journal. Bytes in Git history, other clones or remotes need a history rewrite outside vmem. Requires write=mcp.

tools.name: vmem_assertions_exposure
tools.description: Read-only exposure report for purged assertion payloads: does a commit reachable from local branches, tags or remote-tracking refs still hold a purged entry's line with a payload, matched by seg, seq and hash with the payload's SHA-256 equal to payload_sha256? Reads only assertions/*.jsonl blobs and reports position, hash, commit count and refs per entry, the scanned counts, clean and truncated. It never prints payload text. Bounded per blob (8 MiB), per commit (64 MiB) and overall (100000 commits); crossing a bound sets truncated and is never clean. A vault that is not a Git repository reports clean: null. The scan covers this local repository only. The history rewrite, the force push, reflog expire and gc stay with the person: vmem never runs them. Replies stay within 48 KiB by dropping refs first, then rows with an omitted count.
